title: Saudi point-of-sale spending, Q1 2024 vs Q1 2023

attempts.text: In Q1 2024, the Saudi Arabia point-of-sale card spending (SAMA) showed a significant increase of 13.5% compared to the same quarter in 2023, with an average weekly POS value of SAR 13.00 billion. Among the largest movers, Miscellaneous Goods and Services experienced a notable increase of 30.5% in average weekly value, reaching SAR 1,563 billion. Beverage and Food also saw a substantial rise of 13.1% in average weekly value, totaling SAR 2,064 billion.
